description: This file contains unit tests for the Location class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing hierarchical location retrieval methods such as 'isInHierarchy' and 'getDescendantLocations'.

classes.name: LocationTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Location class, focusing on hierarchy and descendant location retrieval functionality.

methods.name: isInHierarchy_shouldShouldFindLocationInHierarchy
methods.description: Tests whether a location is correctly identified as being in the hierarchy of another location.

methods.name: getDescendantLocations_shouldReturnAllDescendantLocationsIfIncludeRetiredIsTrue
methods.description: Verifies that all descendant locations are returned when includeRetired is true.

methods.name: getDescendantLocations_shouldReturnNonRetiredDescendantLocationsIfIncludeRetiredIsFalse
methods.description: Ensures only non-retired descendant locations are returned when includeRetired is false.
